summary: A coworker asks a new hire to sign a union card in the first week.
realLife: One worker was asked on the first day to sign a union card; a journalist was asked about a week after being hired.
sources: Forge Organizing, worker accounts of a food-plant union drive: https://forgeorganizing.org/article/we-wanted-keep-those-jobs/
inGame: job record (employer, position, workplace) with a coworker tie; needs: a union as an organization record and a card-signing record

turns.summary: The new hire signs right there.
turns.writesBack: tie warms; a side is taken early
